details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:line 212 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `edit_files_touched` handler reads from and redirects output to `${RUNTIME_DIR}/item_body.txt`, truncating the issue body before it is read.
  WHY: The resulting PATCH can replace the entire GitHub issue body with only the `files_touched` block.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-272 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the redirect-aware tokenizer present in the template, so the hook copies are not byte-identical and the root hook does not correctly parse redirected push commands.
  WHY: The root hook can misinterpret numeric push refspecs when output is redirected, while the template copy can mishandle chained redirections.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:335 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_guarded_git_invocations` lacks the `|| exit` continuation guard after a failed `cd`.
  WHY: A subsequent `git push` can be checked using the failed `cd` target rather than the session checkout.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The environment-assignment handling does not recognize `+=` or invalidate the working directory when `GIT_DIR` or `GIT_WORK_TREE` is appended.
  WHY: A push after appending to these variables can be checked against the wrong directory.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:430-444 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` lacks `remote_provided` handling and recognition of the listed abbreviated remote options.
  WHY: `git push --repo https://github.com/... origin HEAD` can have its remote name discarded when determining refspecs.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:465-472 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` does not resolve a `HEAD` destination to the current branch.
  WHY: `git push origin HEAD` is checked as though the destination were a branch literally named `HEAD`.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1316-1330 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `_evaluate_bash` does not replace the push target tip with the resolved source SHA.
  WHY: A non-HEAD source ref can remain unverified when the merged-PR ancestry check runs.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:259-281 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The template tokenizer does not reset `last_segment_word_end` after consuming a file-descriptor digit.
  WHY: The next descriptor check can compute an incorrect offset and fail to recognize a valid descriptor.
- tests/test_audit_plans_command.py:29-30 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The root and template `audit-plans.md` files differ, failing the byte-parity test.
  WHY: `test_template_parity` fails in `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, causing the aggregate `lint` check to fail.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15757-15767 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `ai:unblock-closed` handling closes a project before checking `UNBLOCK_JUDGE_ENABLED`.
  WHY: Disabling the flag after the label is applied still lets the next poll mark the project abandoned and close its tracking issue, contrary to the documented kill-switch behavior.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The merged-PR guard must “distinguish numeric branch refspecs from adjacent unquoted file descriptors before checking push destinations.”
  expected_change_site: `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py` and `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`, `_shell_segments_with_operators`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-272` lacks redirect awareness and the `test_redirection_keeps_numeric_push_refspecs` test is absent; `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:262-281` lacks `last_segment_word_end` tracking and reset, so the copies diverge.
- requirement: “Edited `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:94-107` with numeric-refspec and redirection regressions.” and “Edited `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:102-105` with chained-redirection regressions.”
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py`, `test_redirection_keeps_numeric_push_refspecs`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The test function is absent; the claimed lines contain `test_canonical_api_writes_do_not_request_extra_confirmation`, and the four chained-redirection cases are not present.
- requirement: CI must be green; `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and aggregate `lint` must pass.
  expected_change_site: `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `test_audit_plans_command.py::test_template_parity` fails because the root and template command files differ; the cited diffs do not update the root command file.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-272 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook copy contains the pre-PR simple tokenizer without redirect awareness.
  WHY: The merged-PR guard can parse `git push origin 2 > /tmp/push.log` without recognizing the redirection, potentially inspecting the wrong push target.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:335 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks the `|| exit` continuation guard.
  WHY: A failed `cd` followed by `exit` and then `git push` can be evaluated using the wrong directory.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook's environment-assignment regex does not match append operators (`+=`).
  WHY: A command with `GIT_DIR+=...` can be treated as a non-env argument, misrouting the push target check.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:430-444 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_push_targets` lacks `remote_provided` handling and recognition of the listed abbreviated remote options.
  WHY: `git push --repo https://github.com/... origin HEAD` can have its remote name discarded when determining refspecs.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:465-472 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook lacks `HEAD` destination resolution.
  WHY: `git push origin HEAD` is checked as though the destination were a branch literally named `HEAD`.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1316-1330 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root hook does not resolve the push source SHA before checking the destination branch.
  WHY: The merged-PR ancestry check can continue with the unverified source string instead of the resolved SHA.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:259-281 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The template copy lacks `last_segment_word_end` tracking and reset.
  WHY: A subsequent descriptor check can compute an incorrect offset and fail to recognize a valid file descriptor.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-272 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The root and template hook copies are not byte-identical.
  WHY: The root hook cannot correctly parse redirected push commands, while the template hook can partially parse them.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description states "The merged-PR guard checks a numeric push refspec even when output is redirected (`git push origin 2 > out`); only an adjacent, unquoted descriptor (`2>out`) is removed from the parsed command."
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, function _shell_segments_with_operators
  Evidence of absence: The root hook file on disk at .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:249-272 contains the pre-PR simple tokenizer with no redirect-awareness whatsoever. The function has no redirect_target variable, no last_segment_word_end tracking, no file-descriptor digit check, and no redirection token detection. The test function test_redirection_keeps_numeric_push_refspecs is also absent from tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py. The full redirect-aware parser changes are present in the PR diff but not in the actual branch checkout.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Requirement: The PR description states the merged-PR guard "distinguish numeric branch refspecs from adjacent unquoted file descriptors before checking push destinations." The agents.md update documents that ".claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and its workflow-templates/ twin distinguish numeric branch refspecs from adjacent unquoted file descriptors."
  Expected change site: Both .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  Evidence of absence: The root hook has none of the redirect-aware changes. The template hook is missing last_segment_word_end tracking. The two copies do not match byte-for-byte, violating the documented contract that "the copies stay byte-identical."
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:line 212 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In the `edit_files_touched` operation handler, jq reads from `${RUNTIME_DIR}/item_body.txt` while stdout is redirected to the same path.
  WHY: The shell truncates the destination before jq runs, so the subsequent PATCH can replace the issue body with only the new `files_touched` block.
- tests/test_audit_plans_command.py:lines 29-30 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_template_parity` asserts byte parity between `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` and `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md`, but the files differ.
  WHY: `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails with an AssertionError, causing the aggregate required CI check to fail.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:line 269
  PROBLEM: The hardening suggestion is to guard the descriptor check with `last_segment_word_end > 0`.
  WHY: Resetting `last_segment_word_end` to 0 can make `fd_start` negative, resulting in an empty slice; explicitly guarding avoids that negative slice evaluation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
